  cardMarketContent = '## Far From Home: Post-Endgame Spider-Man

Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019) was the first MCU film after Endgame, dealing with the aftermath of Tony Stark''s death. Jake Gyllenhaal as Mysterio added A-list star power, and the film''s shocking mid-credits reveal made it one of the most talked-about MCU endings.

### Key Sets

The **2019 Upper Deck Spider-Man: Far From Home** set features Jake Gyllenhaal''s Mysterio autograph as the centerpiece, alongside returning favorites Tom Holland and Zendaya.

### Market Trends

Jake Gyllenhaal (Mysterio) autograph cards are highly sought after due to his A-list status and the character''s iconic illusion sequences. Tom Holland and Zendaya cards continue to appreciate as both actors'' careers skyrocketed. The identity reveal mid-credits scene cards are unique collectibles.',

- **Tom Holland Far From Home Auto** — Post-Endgame Spider-Man ($4,000+)
- **Zendaya as MJ Romance Auto** — Peak Zendaya popularity ($3,000+)
- **Identity Reveal Moment Card** — Shocking mid-credits scene
- **Samuel L. Jackson as Nick Fury Auto** — Skrull twist card ($1,500+)
- **2019 Upper Deck FFH Sketch Cards** — Original 1/1 European adventure artwork',
  content = '## The World After Endgame

Spider-Man: Far From Home was the perfect epilogue to the Infinity Saga. Set in the aftermath of Endgame, it deals with Peter Parker''s grief over Tony Stark''s death while introducing one of the MCU''s most creative villains in Mysterio. The film''s mid-credits scene — revealing Spider-Man''s identity to the world — was one of the most shocking MCU moments ever.

## The Legacy

- **Post-Endgame World** — First film to explore the aftermath of the Snap and Tony''s sacrifice
- **Mysterio** — Jake Gyllenhaal delivered a masterclass in deception and manipulation
- **Identity Reveal** — Spider-Man''s secret identity exposed to the world changed everything
- **The Blip** — Established the MCU term for the five-year period of the Snap
- **Tony Stark''s Legacy** — Peter''s journey to step out of Iron Man''s shadow

## Fun Facts

- Jake Gyllenhaal was so nervous about joining the MCU that Tom Holland had to calm him down on his first day
- The Mysterio illusion sequences were some of the most complex VFX in MCU history
- The mid-credits scene featuring J.K. Simmons as J. Jonah Jameson was kept secret from almost everyone
- The film was shot on location in Venice, Prague, London, and Berlin
- The "Nick Fury" in the film is actually Talos the Skrull — revealed in the post-credits scene

## Viewing Context

Spider-Man: Far From Home is the **twenty-third MCU film** and the final entry in Phase 3, closing out the Infinity Saga. It takes place eight months after Endgame and directly addresses the world''s grief over Tony Stark. The identity reveal sets up the events of Spider-Man: No Way Home.',

It became the first Spider-Man film to cross $1 billion."},{"question":"What happens at the end of Far From Home?","answer":"In the shocking mid-credits scene, Mysterio frames Spider-Man for his death and releases doctored footage revealing Peter Parker''s identity to the world. J. Jonah Jameson (J.K. Simmons) broadcasts it globally."},{"question":"What Far From Home cards are valuable?","answer":"Jake Gyllenhaal Mysterio autos ($2,000+) are the centerpiece. Tom Holland post-Endgame autos ($4,000+) and Zendaya romance-era autos ($3,000+) are also premium as both actors'' careers peaked."},{"question":"Is Far From Home the last Phase 3 movie?","answer":"Yes — Spider-Man: Far From Home is officially the final film of Phase 3 and the Infinity Saga. It serves as an epilogue to Endgame, dealing with the aftermath of Tony Stark''s death and the Blip."}]',
  status = 'published',
